# DSH Theme Studio
Package: `dsh-visual-styles`

A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin with a left-sidebar entry that switches the
whole app between **5 s

tudio styles** and **43 reference themes** (28 families)
adapted from a ChatGPT macOS software-theme

d **43 reference themes** (28 families)
adapted from a ChatGPT macOS software-theme seed stylesheet.
## Studio styles
| Style | Light / dark | Character |

| 纸墨 Paper | Light | Warm paper, soft ink, vermilion accent, serif type |
| 深海 Abyss | Dark | Deep b

lue-green surfaces, luminous teal accent |
| 像素 Pixel | Dark | Hard corners, monospace type, lime/ma

genta, CRT scanlines |
| 霓虹 Neon | Dark | Midnight violet, electric cyan and magenta glow |
| 森野 Gro
ve | Light | Moss, linen, terracotta, grounded contrast |
## Reference themes
The second section contains 43 light/dark variants across 28 families:

Absolutely · Ayu · Catppuccin · Codex · Dracula · Everforest · GitHub ·
Gruvbox · Linear · Lobster ·

Material · Matrix · Monokai · Night Owl · Nord ·
Notion · One · Oscurange · Proof · Raycast · Rose

Pine · Sentry · Solarized ·
Temple · Tokyo Night · Vercel · VS Code Plus · Xcode

Each variant has its own compact card, grouped by family. The reference section
has a search box tha

t filters by theme, family, variant, or light/dark mode. The
five studio styles use the same compact

card layout, so the chooser starts with
a short, scannable first screen.
## Use

1. Open **视觉风格 / Visual styles** in the left sidebar.
2. Pick a studio card, or search and pick a re

ference theme. It applies to the
entire Harness UI immediately: sidebar, chat, composer, menus, dial

ogs,
code blocks, and status colors.
3. Use **恢复系统外观 / Restore app appearance** to return to the bui

lt-in
light / dark / system setting.
4. The last custom choice is stored in this browser's `localSto

rage`; switching
back to a built-in appearance in Settings clears it.

If the sidebar entry does not appear immediately after installation, refresh
the page once (`Cmd+R`

ebar entry does not appear immediately after installation, refresh
the page once (`Cmd+R` on macOS).
## How it works

- Each theme is registered through DSH's `ctx.theme` extension point with a
broad set of `--dsw-*` s

emantic tokens, so every part of the shell follows the
selected theme.
- The 43 reference themes are

generated from the reference file's seeds:
background, foreground, accent, diff colors, syntax colo

rs, UI/code fonts,
contrast, and window opacity. Missing semantic colors are derived from those
seed

s; text contrast is raised to at least 4.5:1 where needed.
- Pixel mode adds scoped CSS under
`html[

data-dsh-theme-studio="pixel"]`: square corners, monospace UI, chunky
elevation, and a subtle scanli

ne overlay.
- The launcher is registered in `sidebar.panellist`; the chooser is registered
in the ro

ot-scoped `main` keyed slot under the same `theme-studio` key.
- No DSH Client package is imported.

React comes from the browser module table;
controls and cards are plain React elements styled with t

heme tokens.
- No network requests, remote fonts, or image assets are used. The icon is an
inline SV

me tokens.
- No network requests, remote fonts, or image assets are used. The icon is an
inline SVG.

ication: applied`.

pact cards and the reference section with 43 cards rendered.

See NOTICE.md for attribution and trademark notes. The reference
theme names belong to their respect

ive projects; this plugin bundles only
derived color and typography values, not their source code or

ects; this plugin bundles only

## Known limits

- Third-party theme ids are an in-process extension and do not enter DSH's
built-in `ui-theme` setti

ngs schema, so this plugin persists its own choice in
`localStorage`.
- Fonts are limited to locally

installed families; each reference theme falls
back to the host stack when its named font is missin

g.
- The reference file's named fonts (Inter, Satoshi, Geist, JetBrains Mono, etc.)
are not bundled.

Install them locally if you want the exact intended typography.
- A running page needs one refresh

to pick up a newly installed/replaced client
bundle; that is DSH's client module behavior, not a plu

gin setting.
- The reference theme seeds are color/typography data only; no ChatGPT artwork
or asset

The reference theme seeds are color/typography data only; no ChatGPT artwork
or assets are included.
